description.fr-FR: Les vingt et une prières de Thérèse (Pri 1–21), de la petite prière à la Vierge de son enfance à « Si j’étais la Reine du Ciel » (8 septembre 1897), son dernier écrit : le billet de profession, l’Offrande à l’Amour miséricordieux (1895), la Consécration à la Sainte Face, les prières pour l’abbé Bellière et pour obtenir l’humilité. Texte authentique de l’édition du Centenaire, d’après les archives du Carmel de Lisieux.
description.en-US: The twenty-one prayers of Thérèse (Pri 1–21), from the little prayer to the Virgin of her childhood to “If I were the Queen of Heaven” (8 September 1897), her last writing: the profession note, the Offering to Merciful Love (1895), the Consecration to the Holy Face, the prayers for Abbé Bellière and for humility. The authentic text of the Centenary edition, from the archives of the Carmel of Lisieux.
description.pt-BR: As vinte e uma orações de Teresinha (Pri 1–21), da pequena oração à Virgem de sua infância a «Se eu fosse a Rainha do Céu» (8 de setembro de 1897), seu último escrito: o bilhete de profissão, a Oferenda ao Amor Misericordioso (1895), a Consagração à Santa Face, as orações pelo abade Bellière e para obter a humildade. Texto autêntico da edição do Centenário, segundo os arquivos do Carmelo de Lisieux.

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Lisieux (Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire)

sources.edition: Archives du Carmel de Lisieux, one page per prayer (e.g. /archive/j-m-j-t/ for Pri 6), the transcription read from each page's json-cahiers data (folio by folio) or, for Pri 15 and 16, from the page text through the REST API. The Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire text.
sources.description: Thérèse's text only. The editors' notes are left out: the reading note "(Autre lecture…)" under Pri 19 and the description of the verso of Pri 21. Where a sentence runs over a folio side it is joined.
sources.tierEvidence: Thérèse died in 1897; the prayers were first published in 1988-92 (NEC) or earlier in the Carmel's collections, at any rate more than 25 years ago (CPI art. L123-4). The site states no terms (its mentions légales page is empty, checked 2026-11-01); the editors' notes are not taken.
